comment: Iteration B / B1: lifecycle state-algebra inventory. Derived from OWNERS and WRITE SITES (not grep estimates): node_services.ExecutorNodeServices.record is the central committer; handlers merge routing/counter keys; the runner injects per-segment context; suspension/result_assembly project. Rules: accumulate = prior entries survive the declared scope (by key or append); replace = latest value wins; reset = re-initialized at the named boundary; derive = pure projection of other state. The guard test (test_contract_guards.py::test_lifecycle_algebra_inventory_is_complete) locks this table to RESERVED_STATE_KEYS both ways, so a planted state channel fails BY NAME.

payload.scope: every node completion (latest node output; branch passes payload through unchanged by design)

engine_context.scope: injected per run/resume segment by the executor; never persisted

node_outputs.scope: run (cumulative across retrace/resume); a REVISIT replaces only that node's key — sibling keys must survive; '__input__' pinned at start; output_key aliases written alongside

node_inputs.scope: run; latest input per node id

node_results.scope: run; ONE entry per node visit — full history, never collapsed to latest-per-node

node_status.scope: run; latest status per node id

branch_decisions.scope: run; latest decision label per branch node

routes.scope: run; latest route per node id (continue/halt/__timeout__/decision labels)

transition_counts.scope: run; per 'source|label' traversal counter, increment-only — pre-set loop gates read the LIVE value

eval_counters.scope: run; nested per-evaluator counters (retry/retrace rounds), increment-only

attempts.scope: run; latest attempt count per node id

artifacts.scope: run; append-only across attempts/rounds/segments — evidence never shrinks

status.scope: run; running -> failed/requires_user_input at commit sites; terminal envelope status derived by result assembly
status.note: snapshot carries 'reason' instead; wait-record status lifecycle is coordinator-owned (waits.py), not this channel

error.scope: run; latest failure message (set on failed commits)

fallback_reason.scope: run; set when an evaluator fallback accepted; last fallback wins

workflow_context.scope: injected by WorkflowRunner per segment (observability identity)

workflow_goal.scope: injected by WorkflowRunner per segment; goal identity itself is sealed in the snapshot envelope (typed WorkflowGoal), not in this channel

usage_summary.scope: cumulative across ALL segments of a run (H2: resume rebuilds the session from snapshot.usage so budgets stay cumulative); events append via usage_events

plan_artifact.scope: run; the OBJECT is replaced per planner completion, but its retained content must MERGE: replan keeps prior tasks (_merge_replanned_plan) and metadata.task_outputs accumulates by task key across rounds (GAP-1 fix, both fold surfaces)
plan_artifact.note: nested PlanTask.status/output_ref/error are per-task replace; accepted-None tasks carry no dangling output_ref

resume_suspended_node.scope: set only when a segment starts from a snapshot; identifies THE suspension being resumed; replay consumes it

resume_event.scope: set at resume; delivered to the suspended node exactly once (machine_replay_done gates re-delivery); later nodes/waits in the same segment must never see it

machine_replay_done.scope: False at segment start from snapshot; True once the suspended node re-executed (or timeout-routed) — the one-shot latch for resume_event delivery

pending_retrace_provenance.scope: set by the evaluate retrace route; consumed exactly once when the target node re-runs (cleared on every return path); segment-local BY DESIGN — consumption happens at the retraced invocation before any suspension, so it is deliberately not snapshot-persisted (B0 regression asserts visit 4 sees None)

MachineSnapshot.scope: identity-sealed projection of the accumulate-class channels at suspension time; wire-validated on resume (decode boundary re-seals); segment-local reset-class channels deliberately excluded

WorkflowRunResult.scope: terminal envelope projected from final state + session aggregates; never a second source of truth

observation_bundle.scope: trace/usage/details/artifacts appended per segment under one logical run group; sealed by the bundle contract (meta v2)

trace.scope: per segment result envelope; grouped reader recomposes the full lifecycle; child runs slice via ancestor-chain scopes

usage_events.scope: append per capability call; cumulative across segments through snapshot.usage restore
